text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A after large gains, which felt satisfying, but I should consider how each sale changes my overall allocation and future risk rather than focusing only on locking in gains.","My account value fell in some periods and rose in others; short-term moves are a reminder to assess the full portfolio and its history, not react to one month’s performance.","I trade infrequently, so I should make deliberate decisions based on diversification, risk and my long-term needs, while remembering that losses feel especially painful to me."]}
